definitions.explanation: The craft of making decorative or practical objects from wood, especially as a traditional art form. Encompasses joinery, carving, lacquered wares, and similar techniques.

examples.japanese: {木工芸|もっこうげい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}い→習う：00479_narau⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{木工芸|もっこうげい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|さか}ん→盛ん：01239_sakan⟧だ。
⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧{木工芸|もっこうげい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}えて→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧いきたい。
examples.english: I want to pass on traditional woodcraft techniques to the next generation.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{木工|もっこう}→木工：13063_mokkou⟧ (woodwork) + ⟦{芸|げい}→芸：19343_gei⟧ (art, craft). Note the geminate っ: もくこう → もっこう.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧{木工芸|もっこうげい}: traditional woodcraft
- {木工芸|もっこうげい}{家|か}: woodcraft artist
- {木工芸|もっこうげい}{品|ひん}: woodcraft items; wooden craft goods

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{木工|もっこう}→木工：13063_mokkou⟧: woodwork — broader, includes industrial woodworking
- {木彫|もくちょう}り: wood carving — narrower, focused on carving
- {指物|さしもの}: traditional joinery — wooden furniture made without nails
